heading.title: Registration of Institutions for Persons with Disabilities and Grants to Such Institutions

article.title: Assistance to registered institutions.
article.content: The appropriate Government may within the limits of their economic capacity and development, grant financial assistance to registered institutions to provide services and to implement the schemes and programmes in pursuance of the provisions of this Act.
article.html:
55Assistance to registered institutions.

Section 55 · Chapter IX · page 21 of the Act

The appropriate Government may within the limits of their economic capacity and development, grant financial assistance to registered institutions to provide services and to implement the schemes and programmes in pursuance of the provisions of this Act.
